text.insert: The manual knowledge.process route asks the same background processor to drain eligible work; it does not create a second materialization path. The server enables it only when queued work exists and blocks it while the materializer lease is owned or retry backoff leaves nothing eligible.

The action is routine and does not require confirmation. Its response and subsequent harness state view show queue counts, active processing, failures, and any advanced published revision. Automatic processing remains active; the trigger is an operator acceleration and recovery seam.
